title: Symphony No. 7 in A major, Op. 92 – II. Allegretto
source: purchased by Nomade (lossless file); no audio is published here, only analysis
tempo_note: automatic estimate, may be doubled or halved
spectrogram_text: One obstinate rhythm almost all the way through. Instruments are added layer by layer until about 2:22. From about 3:13 to 4:22 the music turns from A minor to A major. The loudest block of the whole movement is 6:26–6:48. Near the end, short isolated chords separated by silences, and a final A minor chord.
